data.description: The acid of a tenebrous worm's bite affects only organic matter - as it dissolves creatures, it converts their flesh to shadow that swiftly fades away, leaving raw, jagged wounds behind.  In dim light, acid damage dealt by a tenebrous worm's bite increases to 8d6 of damage, while in darkness or bright light, the acid damage is reduced to 4d6.
